vitamin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

vitamin.sentenceEn: I'm always baffled when I walk into a pharmacy and see shelves bursting with various vitamins , extracts and other supplements, all promising to accelerate or promote weight loss.
vitamin.translationZh: 每次走进药店，看到货架上摆满各种维生素、提取物和其他补充剂，全都标榜能加速或促进减肥，我总是感到困惑。
vitamin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

vitamin.sentenceEn: Why did vitamin therapy become less popular in the 1950s?
vitamin.translationZh: 为什么维生素疗法在20世纪50年代变得不那么受欢迎了？

virus.sentenceEn: If a person is infected with a virus or bacteria, for example, their odor will be abnormal, and dogs are able to smell that change even if the human can't, because dogs have a much more powerful sense of smell than humans.
virus.translationZh: 例如，如果一个人感染了病毒或细菌，其体味就会发生异常变化，而狗能够嗅出这种变化，即使人类无法察觉——因为狗的嗅觉远比人类灵敏得多。
virus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

virus.sentenceEn: It was easy to feel depressed by the wars in different parts of the world, the spread of deadly viruses or terror attacks.
virus.translationZh: 面对世界各地的战争、致命病毒的蔓延以及恐怖袭击，人们很容易感到沮丧。
virus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

virus.sentenceEn: A few weeks ago, a well-meaning professor tried to explain the physiological process behind viruses and the human body in a tweet and was immediately criticized for a mistake in his information.
virus.translationZh: 几周前，一位善意的教授试图在推特上解释病毒与人体背后的生理过程，却因信息有误而立即受到批评。
virus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

virus.sentenceEn: There have been so many viruses going around this winter.
virus.translationZh: 今年冬天流感肆虐，病毒特别多。
virus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

virus.sentenceEn: What's the possible advantage of virus therapy according to Prof. Seymour?
virus.translationZh: 根据西摩教授的观点，病毒疗法可能具有什么优势？

virus.sentenceEn: It is comparable to that of virus .
virus.translationZh: 这类似于病毒的传播方式。

volume.sentenceEn: Combined with machine learning of anticipated order volumes and the minute-by-minute cooking data generated by systems such as QSR, that robot fleet could deliver almost instantly.
volume.translationZh: 结合对预期订单量的机器学习，以及由 QSR 等系统生成的每分钟烹饪数据，该机器人机群几乎可以实现即时交付。

volume.sentenceEn: Stop and go were insufficient for the new volumes of cars zooming through intersections.
volume.translationZh: 面对在交叉路口疾驰而过的庞大车流，原有的启停控制方式已显得捉襟见肘。

volume.sentenceEn: Different rates of speech and levels of voice volume can erode symmetry as well.
volume.translationZh: 不同的语速和音量大小也会破坏对称性。
volume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

volume.sentenceEn: Though a significant body of research has examined dog cognition previously, the authors of this new study found little to warrant the volume of work that has been devoted to the topic.
volume.translationZh: 尽管此前已有大量研究探讨过狗的认知能力，但这项新研究的作者发现，这些研究投入的工作量与研究价值并不相称。
volume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

volume.sentenceEn: Who particularly benefits from the rising volume of trade?
volume.translationZh: 谁特别从不断增长的贸易量中受益？

volume.sentenceEn: It has to do with the type and volume of the background noise.
volume.translationZh: 这与背景噪音的类型和音量有关。

virtual.sentenceEn: The decline of civil discourse stems in part from the fact that it is so easy for people to watch news about, buy products from, and engage—in both the virtual and real worlds—only with those of similar backgrounds and ideologies.
virtual.translationZh: 公民话语的衰落，部分源于人们可以轻易地只关注与自己背景和意识形态相似者的新闻、购买他们的产品，并在虚拟和现实世界中仅与这类人互动。

virtual.sentenceEn: The authors, Carlos Monteiro of the University of São Paulo and Arne Astrup of Novo Nordisk Foundation, will discuss the issue in a live virtual debate August 14th during NUTRITION 2024 LIVE ONLINE.
virtual.translationZh: 作者——圣保罗大学的卡洛斯·蒙泰罗和诺和诺德基金会的阿恩·阿斯特鲁普，将在8月14日的2024年营养学年会（线上直播）期间，就这一问题展开一场线上直播辩论。
virtual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

virtual.sentenceEn: A virtual coach then uses that information to suggest a personalised training regime.
virtual.translationZh: 然后，虚拟教练会利用这些信息推荐个性化的训练方案。
virtual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

virtual.sentenceEn: But humans are uniquely imaginative, and we use our evolved imagination to travel into virtual worlds that are full of danger.
virtual.translationZh: 但人类拥有独特的想象力，我们运用进化而来的想象力，进入充满危险的虚拟世界。
virtual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第3句

virtual.sentenceEn: TD is a virtual medical service financially supported by one of the nation's nonprofit organizations.
virtual.translationZh: Teledaktar（TD）是一项虚拟医疗服务，由该国的一家非营利组织提供资金支持。

virtual.sentenceEn: It triggers their imagination to travel into dangerous virtual worlds.
virtual.translationZh: 这激发了他们的想象力，让他们进入危险的虚拟世界进行探索。

variable.sentenceEn: "Learning from less variable input is often fast, but may fail to generalise to new stimuli."
variable.translationZh: 从变化较小的输入中学习通常速度很快，但可能无法推广到新的刺激。
variable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

variable.sentenceEn: One theory is that more variable input can highlight which aspects of a task are relevant and which are not.
variable.translationZh: 有一种理论认为，更多变的输入可以突出显示任务的哪些方面是相关的，哪些是不相关的。
variable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

variable.sentenceEn: A third reason has to do with the way memory works: when training is variable , learners are forced to actively reconstruct their memories.
variable.translationZh: 第三个原因与记忆的工作方式有关：当训练具有可变性时，学习者被迫主动重建他们的记忆。
variable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

variable.sentenceEn: Although practising in more variable conditions will be slower at first, it will likely make you a better tennis player in the end.
variable.translationZh: 虽然一开始在更多变的条件下练习进度会较慢，但最终很可能会让你成为一名更优秀的网球选手。
variable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

variable.sentenceEn: I suspect that some experts in the field will be keen to address alternative explanations, such as unassessed variables playing a role in the wellbeing decline.
variable.translationZh: 我猜想该领域的一些专家会热衷于探讨其他解释，比如未被评估的变量在幸福感下降中所起的作用。

variable.sentenceEn: Learners receiving variable training are compelled to reorganise their memories.
variable.translationZh: 接受可变训练的学习者被迫重组他们的记忆。

viewer.sentenceEn: M: Many of our viewers will be wondering how they too can take part in this once-in-a-lifetime event.
viewer.translationZh: 男主持人：我们的许多观众可能想知道他们如何也能参与到这个一生仅有一次的活动中来。
viewer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

viewer.sentenceEn: Participants who were heavy viewers of rags-to-riches programmes or frequent viewers had a stronger belief in the American Dream than those who never watched such shows.
viewer.translationZh: 大量观看或经常观看白手起家类节目的参与者比从不观看此类节目的人更强烈地相信美国梦。
viewer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

viewer.sentenceEn: Nowadays, there are unknown, unorthodox opera singers wowing(博得……的喝彩) viewers on TV programs like "America's Got Talent" and "The Voice".
viewer.translationZh: 如今，一些名不见经传、风格另类的歌剧演唱家正在《美国达人秀》和《美国好声音》等电视节目中惊艳观众。

viewer.sentenceEn: This is partly because of the risk that viewers find virtual humans scary.
viewer.translationZh: 部分原因是观众可能会觉得虚拟人物令人毛骨悚然。

viewer.sentenceEn: This refers to the idea that when objects trying to resemble humans aren't quite perfect, they can make viewers feel uneasy because they fall somewhere between obviously non-human and fully human.
viewer.translationZh: 这指的是这样一种观点：当试图模仿人类的物体不够完美时，它们会让观众感到不安，因为这些物体介于明显非人类和完全人类之间。

viewer.sentenceEn: They attract far fewer viewers than reality TV.
viewer.translationZh: 它们吸引的观众比真人秀少得多。

valley.sentenceEn: The Ambury Hills above the village remain untouched by human development, and the Sonora Valley just below it is equally stunning.
valley.translationZh: 村庄上方的安伯里山群仍未受到人类开发的影响，而山脚下的索诺拉山谷同样令人惊叹。
valley.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

valley.sentenceEn: Silicon Valley and the tech industry have led the region into a period of unprecedented wealth and innovation.
valley.translationZh: 硅谷和科技产业引领该地区进入了一个前所未有的财富与创新时期。

valley.sentenceEn: The region's economy has been fundamentally transformed by the technology industry springing from Silicon Valley .
valley.translationZh: 源自硅谷的科技产业从根本上改变了该地区的经济面貌。

valley.sentenceEn: We need to build an effective high-speed commuting system linking the high-priced and crowded Bay Area with the low-priced and low-density Central Valley .
valley.translationZh: 我们需要建立一个高效的高速通勤系统，将房价高昂且拥挤的湾区与房价低廉且人口密度低的中央谷地连接起来。

valley.sentenceEn: What can be found in the Valley of the Kings?
The culture of Silicon Valley ought not to be emulated.
valley.translationZh: 硅谷的文化不应被效仿。

venture.sentenceEn: Many are tourists, but many venture forth on personal or professional business.
venture.translationZh: 许多人是游客，但也有许多人是为了私人事务或商务出差而远行。
venture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

venture.sentenceEn: Sticking with the example of the entrepreneurial venture , numbers are your best friend.
venture.translationZh: 以创业投资为例，数据就是你最好的朋友。

venture.sentenceEn: If you're considering whether to shut down your entrepreneurial venture , for instance, reach out to other founders as opposed to just your business partner.
venture.translationZh: 例如，如果你正在考虑是否关闭你的创业项目，请去联系其他创始人，而不仅仅是咨询你的商业伙伴。

venture.sentenceEn: Working for a new venture comes with a lot of risks.
venture.translationZh: 在一家初创企业工作伴随着诸多风险。
venture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

venture.sentenceEn: The first is inventing a product or service, the second is founding the venture to sell that product or service, and the third is developing the firm so it continues to grow.
venture.translationZh: 第一阶段是研发产品或服务，第二阶段是创立企业来销售该产品或服务，第三阶段是发展企业以实现持续增长。
venture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

venture.sentenceEn: What has science demonstrated regarding the positive culture of a new venture ?
venture.translationZh: 关于新创企业的积极文化，科学已经证明了什么？

virtually.sentenceEn: You'll see, the entire managerial hierarchy wants to see this project implemented as soon as possible, and the board, too, is virtually unanimous in its support.
virtually.translationZh: 你会发现，整个管理层都希望这个项目能尽快落地，而且董事会也几乎一致表示支持。
virtually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第3句

virtually.sentenceEn: Some 30 years ago, quinoa was virtually unheard of outside its native mountains in Bolivia and Peru.
virtually.translationZh: 大约30年前，藜麦在其原产地玻利维亚和秘鲁的山区之外几乎无人知晓。

virtually.sentenceEn: For virtually every disease, the effects are greater on men than they are on women.
virtually.translationZh: 几乎对于所有疾病而言，男性受到的影响都比女性更大。
virtually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

virtually.sentenceEn: Virtually every American can recognize a dollar bill at a mere glance.
virtually.translationZh: 几乎每个美国人都能一眼认出一美元纸币。
virtually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

virtually.sentenceEn: Average incomes in the Bay Area make it virtually impossible for most tenant families to buy a home.
virtually.translationZh: 旧金山湾区的平均收入使得大多数租房家庭几乎不可能购买住房。

virtue.sentenceEn: Many of the studies did show a reduction in the concentration of volatile organic compounds over time, which is likely why people have seized on them to praise the air purifying virtues of plants.
virtue.translationZh: 许多研究确实表明，随着时间的推移，挥发性有机化合物的浓度有所降低，这可能就是为什么人们会抓住这一点来赞扬植物的空气净化功效。
virtue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

virtue.sentenceEn: Being thrifty is no longer a virtue to some people, and they are not alone in holding this view.
virtue.translationZh: 对一些人来说，节俭不再是一种美德，而且持这种观点的并非只有他们。
virtue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

virtue.sentenceEn: By virtue of having the loudest voice, they're able to command greater attention and to further assert their dominance, even when what they're saying doesn't really make much sense.
virtue.translationZh: 凭借着最响亮的声音，他们能够获得更多关注，并进一步巩固自己的主导地位，即便他们所说的话其实没什么道理。
virtue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

virtue.sentenceEn: Honesty was deemed to be more of a sin than a virtue , since it made people feel uncomfortable, or at least it made the most powerful folks feel uncomfortable.
virtue.translationZh: 诚实被视为一种罪过而非美德，因为它让人感到不舒服，或者至少让那些最有权势的人感到不舒服。
virtue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

virtue.sentenceEn: For example, some ancient Western philosophers counsel gratitude that is both enduring and complete, and some Eastern thinkers portray it as not merely an attitude but a virtue to be put into practice.
virtue.translationZh: 例如，一些古代西方哲学家主张感恩应既持久又全然，而一些东方思想家则将感恩不仅视为一种态度，更看作是一种需要践行的美德。

virtue.sentenceEn: It is more of a sin than a virtue .
virtue.translationZh: 与其说是优点，不如说是缺点

vote.sentenceEn: If there's a tie, and we can't come to an agreement, then we'll take it to John and let him cast the deciding vote .
vote.translationZh: 如果出现意见分歧，我们无法达成一致，那么我们会把问题提交给约翰，由他投出决定性的一票。
vote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第2句

vote.sentenceEn: The transformation commenced in a town hall meeting in spring 2008 over 10 years ago now, when an overwhelming majority of neighbors voted in favor of "Motion 836".
vote.translationZh: 这场变革始于十多年前，即2008年春季的一次市民大会，当时绝大多数居民投票支持了"第836号动议"。
vote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

vote.sentenceEn: By and large, when we trade, we trade with strangers; when we vote , we vote for strangers; when we watch, read, or listen to stories, the tellers of the tales are strangers.
vote.translationZh: 总的来说，我们做交易时，是和陌生人交易；我们投票时，是给陌生人投票；我们观看、阅读或聆听故事时，讲故事的也都是陌生人。

vote.sentenceEn: As a possible home for alien life, it has been voted the planet least likely to succeed.
vote.translationZh: 作为外星生命可能的家园，金星被认为是最不可能有生命存在的行星。
vote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

vote.sentenceEn: Just earlier this year, the European Parliament voted in favor of legislation that would stop grocery giants from unfair trading practices that result in overproduction, thus creating waste.
vote.translationZh: 就在今年早些时候，欧洲议会投票通过了一项法案，旨在制止大型食品零售商的不公平交易行为，这类行为导致了生产过剩，进而造成浪费。
vote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

vote.sentenceEn: Ask the board to cast the deciding vote .
vote.translationZh: 请董事会进行决定性投票。

variation.sentenceEn: Central to hereditarian science is a tall claim: that identifiable variations in genetic sequences can predict an individual's aptness to learn, reason and solve problems.
variation.translationZh: 遗传论科学的核心是一个大胆的主张：基因序列中可识别的变异能够预测个体的学习、推理和解决问题的能力。
variation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

variation.sentenceEn: Three researchers analyzed decades of values-based surveys and found that only between 16% and 21% of the variation in cultural values could be explained by differences between countries.
variation.translationZh: 三位研究人员分析了数十年基于价值观的调查，发现文化价值观差异中仅有16%至21%可由国家间差异解释。
variation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

variation.sentenceEn: However, our focus on countries can mask broad variations within them.
variation.translationZh: 然而，我们对国家的关注可能掩盖了国家内部的巨大差异。
variation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

variation.sentenceEn: We easily recognize that there is great variation among the individuals who live near us.
variation.translationZh: 我们很容易发现，身边的人之间存在巨大差异。
variation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

variation.sentenceEn: What a traffic light means is almost the same everywhere despite some variations .
variation.translationZh: 尽管存在一些细微差异，但交通信号灯的含义在世界各地几乎都是一样的。

variation.sentenceEn: Half of a person's total weight variation can be controlled.
variation.translationZh: 一个人体重变化的一半是可以控制的。

vessel.sentenceEn: Nearly three million vessels lie wrecked on the Earth's ocean floor—from old canoes to the Titanic—and likely less than one percent have been explored.
vessel.translationZh: 地球上的海底躺着近三百万艘失事船只——从古老的独木舟到泰坦尼克号——而其中可能只有不到百分之一被探索过。

vessel.sentenceEn: Crew members were up at dawn, dragging sensors from their expedition vessels back and forth, day in and day out, year after year, to detect metal of any kind.
vessel.translationZh: 船员们天一亮就起床，日复一日、年复一年地从考察船上拖拽着传感器来回作业，以探测任何种类的金属。

vessel.sentenceEn: Indeed, it's a bit of a mystery why governments, archaeologists, and treasure hunters can't work together—and why salvors aren't at least given a substantial finder's fee before the original owner takes possession of the vessel and its artifacts.
vessel.translationZh: 的确，令人费解的是，为何政府、考古学家和寻宝者不能携手合作——以及为何在原主收回沉船及其文物之前，打捞者至少不能获得一笔可观的发现者报酬。

vessel.sentenceEn: They were vessels built for war and commerce, crossing the globe carrying everything from coins to cannons, boxes of silver and gold, chests of jewels and porcelain, and pearls from the Caribbean.
vessel.translationZh: 这些船只或是战舰，或是商船，它们航遍全球，所载之物应有尽有：从普通硬币到军用大炮，从整箱的金银到满匣的珠宝瓷器，还有来自加勒比海的珍珠。

vessel.sentenceEn: The artifacts indicated the divers had likely found the wreck of La Trinité, a 16th-century French vessel that had been at the center of a bloody battle between France and Spain that changed the fate of the United States of America.
vessel.translationZh: 这些文物表明，潜水员们很可能发现了16世纪法国船只“三位一体号”的残骸。这艘船曾是法西两国一场血腥海战的核心，而正是这场战役改变了美利坚合众国的命运。

vessel.sentenceEn: The Sunken Military Craft Act of 2004, a US federal act, protects any vessel that was on a military mission, allowing the originating country to claim their ship even centuries later.
vessel.translationZh: 2004年《沉没军事舰艇法案》是一项美国联邦法案，它保护所有执行过军事任务的舰艇，允许其原产国即使在数百年后仍可对其船只提出所有权主张。

victim.sentenceEn: Many of us have fallen victim to an individualistic culture.
victim.translationZh: 我们中的许多人都成了个人主义文化的受害者。
victim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

victim.sentenceEn: This is known as the bystander effect—the more people who witness an event, the less likely anyone in that group is to help the victim .
victim.translationZh: 这被称为旁观者效应——目击事件的人越多，群体中任何人帮助受害者的可能性就越小。
victim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

victim.sentenceEn: Victims of erosion lose their houses, agricultural land and jobs as farmers, fishermen and day laborers.
victim.translationZh: 土地侵蚀的受害者失去了房屋、农田以及作为农民、渔民和日工的生计。

victim.sentenceEn: Forgiveness is vitally important for the mental health of certain victims .
victim.translationZh: 宽恕对某些受害者的心理健康至关重要。
victim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

victim.sentenceEn: Sometimes the victim becomes more empowered when they give themselves permission not to forgive.
victim.translationZh: 有时，当受害者允许自己不原谅时，他们反而会感到更有力量。
victim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

victim.sentenceEn: They fall victim to social conflicts and environmental disturbances.
victim.translationZh: 它们成为社会冲突和环境破坏的受害者。

vegan.sentenceEn: Vegan boots cost the same as the leather originals.
vegan.translationZh: 纯素靴子的价格与真皮原版相同。
vegan.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

vegan.sentenceEn: The researchers of the team predicted that the next year would see a boom in animal-free shoe collections, since they heard shoppers of all ages say they would buy footwear designated as " vegan ", meaning the goods were produced without using any animal or animal part.
vegan.translationZh: 该团队的研究人员预测，明年无动物成分鞋履系列将迎来爆发式增长，因为他们听到各年龄段的消费者都表示会购买标有“纯素”的鞋类产品，即完全不使用任何动物或动物部件生产的商品。
vegan.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

vegan.sentenceEn: There are fur coats that are vegan , plastic vegan belts and shoes made from tree bark or natural rubber labelled vegan .
vegan.translationZh: 市场上出现了纯素皮草大衣、纯素塑料腰带，以及以树皮或天然橡胶为原料制成并标注为纯素的鞋子。
vegan.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

vegan.sentenceEn: The Animal Free Product Society says they've seen a boom in products registered with the vegan trademark.
vegan.translationZh: 无动物产品协会表示，他们发现带有纯素商标的产品数量激增。
vegan.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

vegan.sentenceEn: As well as being on trend, and with a much better ring to it than synthetic leather, the vegan label does convey an important extra distinction.
vegan.translationZh: 除了紧跟潮流，而且比“合成皮革”这个说法听起来悦耳得多之外，“纯素”标签还传达了一个重要的额外含义。
vegan.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

vegan.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say is unclear concerning vegan products?
vegan.translationZh: 说话者认为关于纯素产品，什么是不清楚的？

verbal.sentenceEn: The humor of a comedy of manners relies on verbal wit and playful teasing.
verbal.translationZh: 风尚喜剧的幽默源于语言的机智和戏谑的调侃。
verbal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

verbal.sentenceEn: A group of American researchers compared students' comprehension of verbal material when reading in the presence of background speech, instrumental music or general noise.
verbal.translationZh: 一组美国研究人员比较了学生在有背景言语、器乐或一般噪音的环境中阅读时对语言材料的理解能力。
verbal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

verbal.sentenceEn: The studies suggest that when people read and when they try to remember any verbal material, background speech will inhibit their ability.
verbal.translationZh: 这些研究表明，当人们阅读或试图记忆任何语言材料时，背景语音会抑制他们的能力。
verbal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

verbal.sentenceEn: In addition to the likely negative long-term impact on sales, this verbal trick sends a message that innovations in farming and food processing are unwelcome, eventually leading to less efficiency, fewer choices for consumers, and ultimately, more costly food products.
verbal.translationZh: 除了可能对销售产生长期负面影响外，这种文字游戏还传递出农业和食品加工创新不受欢迎的信号，最终会导致效率降低、消费者选择减少，并且最终会使食品价格上涨。
verbal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

verbal.sentenceEn: That way, the researchers can see if the self-identified verbal learners really learned better when the information was just spoken aloud, for example.
verbal.translationZh: 例如，通过这种方式，研究人员可以了解那些自认为是语言型学习者的学生，在仅通过口头讲解获取信息时，是否真的能学得更好。
verbal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

verbal.sentenceEn: It helps babies to develop their verbal skills.
verbal.translationZh: 这有助于婴儿发展语言能力。

viable.sentenceEn: Project after project helped prove these crops were viable in different environments as alternatives to the staple ones.
viable.translationZh: 一个又一个项目证明，这些作物在不同环境中可作为主粮的替代品，具有可行性。

viable.sentenceEn: M: My father's current financial situation has helped me realize that a more financially viable employment opportunity is not necessarily a bad thing.
viable.translationZh: 男：我父亲目前的财务状况让我意识到，一个经济上更可行的就业机会未必是件坏事。
viable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

viable.sentenceEn: I think the problem is that my topic isn't viable .
viable.translationZh: 我觉得问题在于我的选题不太可行。
viable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

viable.sentenceEn: It serves as a viable alternative to other forms of transport and has gone a long way to alleviate traffic jams in the city centre.
viable.translationZh: 它已成为其他交通方式的可行替代方案，并在缓解市中心交通拥堵方面发挥了重要作用。
viable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

viable.sentenceEn: Currently, the enzyme takes a few days to start breaking down the plastic, far faster than the centuries it takes in the oceans, but the researchers are optimistic this can be speeded up even further and become a viable large-scale process.
viable.translationZh: 目前，这种酶需要几天时间开始分解塑料，这比塑料在海洋中自然降解需要的数百年时间快得多，但研究人员乐观地认为，这一过程可以进一步加速，并成为一种可行的大规模处理方法。
viable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

viable.sentenceEn: Seek financially viable employment opportunities after graduation.
viable.translationZh: 毕业后寻求经济上可行的就业机会。

varied.sentenceEn: In reality, young people of this age group are as varied and multifaceted as any other generation.
varied.translationZh: 事实上，这个年龄段的年轻人与任何其他世代一样，都是多元且多层面的。
varied.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

varied.sentenceEn: Basically, it allows me to have a more varied diet with a far wider assortment of nutrients, because it's not only fruit in my morning juices you see.
varied.translationZh: 基本上，它让我的饮食更加多样化，能摄入的营养种类也丰富得多，因为你知道，我的晨间果汁里可不仅仅只有水果。
varied.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第2句

varied.sentenceEn: But I would say food should always come before supplements and the key to getting as many nutrients as possible is to eat a varied diet with lots of different colors such as frozen berries and dark green vegetables.
varied.translationZh: 但我想说，食物应该永远优先于补充剂，而获取尽可能多营养的关键是摄入多样化的饮食，包含多种不同颜色的食物，比如冷冻浆果和深绿色蔬菜。
varied.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

varied.sentenceEn: That was confirmed in the early 1990s by the American Magellan orbiter, which used radar to peer through the planet's thick clouds and map out a rich, varied , and dynamic surface.
varied.translationZh: 20世纪90年代初，美国麦哲伦号轨道探测器证实了这一点。该探测器利用雷达穿透金星浓密的云层，绘制出了一个丰富多样且充满活力的地表。
varied.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

varied.sentenceEn: It's certainly varied and sometimes bizarre.
varied.translationZh: 这份工作内容确实十分多样，有时甚至有些奇特。
varied.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

varied.sentenceEn: They aren't as varied as their predecessors.
varied.translationZh: 它们不像前代产品那样丰富多样。

virgin.sentenceEn: Home to virgin reefs, rare sharks and vast numbers of exotic fish, the Coral Sea is a unique haven of biodiversity off the northeastern coast of Australia.
virgin.translationZh: 珊瑚海位于澳大利亚东北海岸附近，拥有原始珊瑚礁、珍稀鲨鱼和大量奇异鱼类，是一个独特的生物多样性天堂。
virgin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

virgin.sentenceEn: That means that the FAA could suspend Virgin Galactic's license to fly.
virgin.translationZh: 这意味着美国联邦航空管理局可能会暂停维珍银河公司的飞行执照。
virgin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

virgin.sentenceEn: How Virgin Galactic, regulators and the public respond to this most recent tragedy will determine whether and how soon private space travel can transcend that playground.
virgin.translationZh: 维珍银河公司、监管机构以及公众如何应对这场最新悲剧，将决定私人太空旅行能否以及何时能超越这种'富人游乐场'的范畴。
virgin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

virgin.sentenceEn: After being dogged by technical delays for years, Sir Richard Branson, Virgin Galactic's founder, had recently suggested that a SpaceShipTwo craft would carry its first paying customers as soon as February 2015.
virgin.translationZh: 在多年饱受技术延误困扰后，维珍银河创始人理查德·布兰森爵士最近表示，太空船二号最早将于2015年2月搭载首批付费乘客。
virgin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

virgin.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the space-tourism firm Virgin Galactic?
virgin.translationZh: 关于太空旅游公司维珍银河，我们了解到什么？

virgin.sentenceEn: Suspend Virgin Galactic's licence to take passengers into space.
virgin.translationZh: 吊销维珍银河公司搭载乘客进入太空的执照

vocal.sentenceEn: A vocal minority is even calling on officials to punish those who are benefitting from the economic and housing boom.
vocal.translationZh: 一部分直言不讳的少数群体甚至呼吁官员惩罚那些从经济和住房繁荣中获益的人。

vocal.sentenceEn: Background speech had the biggest negative effect; vocal music was slightly more disruptive than instrumental; and general background noise and silence were least disruptive.
vocal.translationZh: 背景语音的负面影响最大；人声音乐比器乐音乐的干扰性略强；而一般背景噪音和安静环境的干扰性最小。
vocal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

vocal.sentenceEn: British researchers compared the effects of background speech, vocal music, instrumental music, general background noise and silence on short-term memory.
vocal.translationZh: 英国研究人员比较了背景言语、有声音乐、器乐、一般背景噪音和安静环境对短期记忆的影响。
vocal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

vocal.sentenceEn: Yet vocal critics of the food processing industry and food fortification strategies have been left out of the debate.
vocal.translationZh: 然而，食品加工行业和食品强化策略的直言不讳的批评者却被排除在这场辩论之外。
vocal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

vocal.sentenceEn: "I was a main character in Fallout 4, a character by the name of Kellogg, and I never knew that I was doing vocal recording for that game throughout the year and a half."
vocal.translationZh: 我在《辐射4》中为一个名叫凯洛格的主要角色配音，但在整整一年半的时间里，我都不知道自己在为这款游戏录制配音。
vocal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

vocal.sentenceEn: Use vocal material as little as possible.

validate.sentenceEn: It is possible that their emotions were only validated in childhood when they were at their loudest, encouraging them to adopt responses to discomfort that are excessive in most situations.
validate.translationZh: 这可能是因为他们在童年时期，只有在闹得最凶时情绪才会得到认可，这促使他们养成了一种在大多数情况下都表现得过于激进的不适反应方式。
validate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

validate.sentenceEn: The key is to validate without over-identifying.
validate.translationZh: 关键在于给予认可，但不要过度共情。
validate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

validate.sentenceEn: He'll use those data to validate and improve his mathematical flooding model, called TideWatch.
validate.translationZh: 他将利用这些数据来验证并改进其名为TideWatch的洪水数学模型。
validate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

validate.sentenceEn: And research has validated this as a genuine concern for many job applicants.
validate.translationZh: 研究也证实，这确实是许多求职者所担忧的问题。
validate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

validate.sentenceEn: The reason, of course, is that on some level they don't want a solution; they want to be validated in their position that the world is out to get them.
validate.translationZh: 当然，原因在于，在某种程度上他们并不想要解决方案；他们希望自己那种“世界一心要与自己作对”的心态得到认同。
validate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

validate.sentenceEn: Ask them to validate their beliefs with further evidence.
validate.translationZh: 要求他们用更多证据证实自己的信念。

van.sentenceEn: W: Today's camper vans are completely different.
van.translationZh: W：现在的露营车可完全不一样了。
van.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

van.sentenceEn: These are proper vans with full-size beds to sleep in.
van.translationZh: 这些可是正经的房车，里面配有标准尺寸的床铺可以睡觉。
van.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

van.sentenceEn: M: I think my grandfather had a van like that.
van.translationZh: 我爷爷以前好像就有一辆那样的车。
van.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

van.sentenceEn: Will we be able to order at the van ?
van.translationZh: 我们能在房车里点外卖吗？
van.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第5句

van.sentenceEn: What can many camper vans do nowadays according to the woman?
van.translationZh: 根据这位女士的说法，如今许多露营车能做什么？
他曾经有过一辆露营车。

viewpoint.sentenceEn: One of the other things is, rather than just taking one perspective, so rather than looking at aging and health just from the perspective of the psychologist, we are now bringing together a lot of different techniques and a lot of different viewpoints to actually look at the sort of different factors affecting health.
viewpoint.translationZh: 另一个方面是，我们不再局限于单一视角——不再仅从心理学家的角度研究衰老与健康，而是汇集了多种不同的技术和观点，来探究影响健康的各类因素。
viewpoint.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

viewpoint.sentenceEn: Each might have different viewpoints on how to lead one's lifestyle: some prefer simplicity, some love luxuries, some spend extravagantly, some accumulate as much as they can like a country mouse.
viewpoint.translationZh: 每个人对如何生活可能都有不同的看法：有人崇尚简朴，有人喜爱奢华，有人挥霍无度，有人则像田鼠一样拼命积累。
viewpoint.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

viewpoint.sentenceEn: Think about this from a practical, rather than theoretical viewpoint .
viewpoint.translationZh: 从实际而非理论的角度来考虑这个问题。
viewpoint.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

viewpoint.sentenceEn: One viewpoint may tend to get lost because it is expressed more tentatively.
viewpoint.translationZh: 有一种观点可能会因为表达得较为试探而容易被忽略。
viewpoint.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

viewpoint.sentenceEn: And when speaking with others, a young child supposedly cannot consider the listener's viewpoint but "talks to himself without listening to others."
viewpoint.translationZh: 而且在与他人交谈时，幼儿据称无法考虑听者的观点，而是“自言自语，不听他人说话”。

viewpoint.sentenceEn: What is the logic underlying the author's viewpoint ?
viewpoint.translationZh: 作者观点所依据的逻辑是什么？

vocabulary.sentenceEn: In fact, multiple studies have found that electronic books support story comprehension and vocabulary gains beyond what is provided by printed books.
vocabulary.translationZh: 事实上，多项研究发现，电子书在促进故事理解和词汇积累方面的效果，甚至超过了纸质书籍。
vocabulary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

vocabulary.sentenceEn: Some employ their persuasive vocabulary and influential communication style to win workplace arguments by compelling people to perform the intended action.
vocabulary.translationZh: 有些人会运用他们富有说服力的词汇和具有影响力的沟通方式，通过迫使他人按其意图行事来赢得职场争论。
vocabulary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

vocabulary.sentenceEn: Bilingual individuals have been shown to have smaller vocabularies and to take longer in retrieving words from memory when compared to monolinguals.
vocabulary.translationZh: 有研究显示，与单语者相比，双语者的词汇量更小，从记忆中提取词汇所需的时间也更长。

vocabulary.sentenceEn: "You would expect the reading comprehension performance to mirror the vocabulary —it's a cornerstone of comprehension."
vocabulary.translationZh: 你可能会认为阅读理解能力应该反映词汇量——毕竟词汇是理解的基石。

vocabulary.sentenceEn: Therefore, by definition, they had a much weaker English vocabulary than the native speakers.
vocabulary.translationZh: 因此，按理说，他们的英语词汇量比母语为英语的学生要小得多。

vocabulary.sentenceEn: They tested the size of the participants' vocabulary .
vocabulary.translationZh: 他们测试了参与者的词汇量。
